description: The chart illustrates measured “effect” values across multiple language-family categories for four model/condition combinations, shown as grouped bars with error bars. The horizontal axis contains the categories IE-Baltic, IE-Germanic, IE-Indic, IE-Romance, IE-Slavic, IE-other, Isolate, Semitic, and Uralic in that left-to-right order, while the vertical axis is labeled “effect” and uses a linear scale with labeled ticks at 0, 10, 20, 30, and 40 (the plotted range extends slightly below 0 and above 40). Each category displays four adjacent bars corresponding to the legend: mBERT-targ (light blue), XLM-targ (dark blue), mBERT-permute (light green), and XLM-permute (dark green), each with vertical error bars. Approximate bar heights are: IE-Baltic ~22 (mBERT-targ), ~15 (XLM-targ), ~6 (mBERT-permute), ~5 (XLM-permute); IE-Germanic ~13, ~12, ~9, ~9; IE-Indic ~4, ~4, ~18, ~16; IE-Romance ~15, ~12, ~2, ~2; IE-Slavic ~14, ~11, ~9, ~8; IE-other ~14, ~11, ~5, ~5; Isolate ~35, ~25, ~1, ~1; Semitic ~10, ~11, ~9, ~9; Uralic ~28, ~21, ~1, ~1. The bars are not visually sorted by magnitude, and no individual bars appear specially emphasized beyond the consistent color scheme and the presence of error bars.
